## 🧠 NEURAX

**The Analytical Compiler for Neural Network Architectures**

Predict training costs, memory usage, and performance **before** you train. In 50ms. No GPU required.

### What We Do

NEURAX helps ML engineers and researchers:
- 🎯 Estimate training costs before committing GPU resources
- 💾 Predict VRAM usage and avoid OOM errors
- ⚡ Compare hardware configurations side-by-side
- 🚀 Optimize architectures for target hardware

### Key Features

- **8 architecture families** - Transformer, MoE, CNN, SSM, Diffusion, RNN, GNN, GAN
- **150 configurable blocks** - Drag-and-drop visual canvas
- **<50ms analysis** - Full 10-pass IR pipeline
- **Commercial software** - closed-source, all rights reserved

| Component | Technology |
|-----------|------------|
| Core Engine | Rust |
| Frontend | React 18 + TypeScript |
| AI Agent | FastAPI + LangChain |
| API | Actix-Web (Rust) |

### Get Started

```bash
# Clone and run
git clone https://github.com/rustnew/NEURAX.git
cd NEURAX
./start-dev.sh

# Or use Docker
docker compose up -d
```
